name: Macro-catchment water harvesting
decision_proposal: Retain umbrella; no independent intervention count
rationale: Overlaps named ponds/dams/tanks; unspecified purpose cannot inherit storage or recharge direction.

name: Contour bunds / ridges
proposed_group_label: In situ; donor-catchment variants to micro-catchment
rationale: Same name can describe capture in place or external runoff interception; geometry/name alone cannot decide.

name: Planting pits / Zai
proposed_group_label: In situ; donor-catchment variants to micro-catchment
decision_proposal: Keep; check donor area and footprint
rationale: Point pits may manage a field but pit footprint is not field area; distinguish managed area from structure area.

name: Conservation tillage / mulching
decision_proposal: Keep; check overlap with soil-management recipes
rationale: Retain only specified soil/vegetation management; avoid duplicate benefit/area accounting across NbS.

name: Semi-circular bunds
rationale: Distinct runoff donor and receiving basin justify boundary with capture in place.

name: Eyebrow terraces
rationale: Name terrace does not establish bench-terrace limiting factors; donor-to-receiver relation matters.

name: Runoff strips
rationale: Bare donor and receiving crop strips are not interchangeable with mulch/infiltration management.

name: Farm ponds
rationale: Storage retention and seepage limits differ from intentional recharge; conventional lined storage alone does not establish NbS.

name: Check dams
decision_proposal: Require purpose; no automatic family assignment
rationale: Channel barrier name does not establish soil-permeability direction or ecological compatibility.

name: Percolation tanks
rationale: Infiltration/recharge function differs from impermeable surface storage; hydrogeological review required.

name: Bench terraces
rationale: Earthwork must be linked to soil/ecosystem management; no global slope range authorized from old scheme.

name: Stone bunds / fanya juu
proposed_group_label: Terracing when progressive slope reshaping; otherwise in situ/micro-catchment
rationale: Contour stone lines and progressive terraces need functional classification; material alone is insufficient.

name: Rooftop / domestic harvesting
proposed_group_label: Out of project scope; historical/contextual only
decision_proposal: Exclude from active target scope; retain records
rationale: Existing Pete decision; not an open eligibility vote. qualitative_only alone does not communicate exclusion.

name: Spate / floodwater harvesting
rationale: Ephemeral flood spreading and sediment management differ from permanent storage; no automatic merge into runoff storage.

name: Cross-cutting envelope (family-agnostic)
decision_proposal: Keep metadata; exclude from intervention totals
rationale: Pooled evidence must not become standalone practice or independent extra vote.

name: Sand dams
rationale: Sediment aquifer and seasonal sandy-channel context differ from surface pond retention and general recharge.

name: Subsurface dams
rationale: Buried barrier retains water in alluvium; do not treat as generic surface-storage pond.

name: Small communal tanks / reservoirs
decision_proposal: Group with storage only after scope check
rationale: Scale/communal ownership does not establish NbS eligibility; retain distinct source context and footprint.
